title: EAFIX Approved Physical File Migration Map
purpose: Machine-oriented execution map for an agent to relocate, regenerate, merge, split, or retire the 86 files that already received content-validated ownership decisions.

scope_guard.rule: The agent may act only on source paths explicitly listed in operations. Candidate matches from the larger name/path analysis are not authorized physical moves.
out_of_scope: All unresolved or unmatched repository files.
All name-only candidate mappings that do not appear in the 86-file approved decision set.
Any new path introduced after the pinned commit unless separately revalidated.

authoritative_inputs.role: Approved source/target action manifest for 86 reviewed files.
Detailed ownership, evidence, transformation, and validation decisions.

required_workflow: Create a dedicated migration branch from the pinned base commit.
Require a clean working tree before every phase.
Run operations in phase order and honor depends_on links.
Stop immediately on missing sources, unexpected target collisions, parse failures, test failures, or unresolved reference updates.
Use git mv for mechanically direct relocations; never use copy-and-delete for those operations.
For transforms, write and validate canonical outputs before removing or replacing sources.
Never overwrite an existing target silently.
Never duplicate a global contract into a module folder.
Never move an unlisted file based solely on a filename or folder-name match.
Produce a machine-readable execution report keyed by operation_id.
execution_contract.commit_strategy: one commit per phase, except code consolidation and split/rewrite operations should use one focused commit per operation
required_final_checks: Relevant focused tests followed by the full test suite.
Stale-path scan for every removed source path.

phase_order.purpose: Execute approved one-source/one-target moves and the single approved global rename.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Commit after all direct relocations and reference updates pass.

phase_order.purpose: Regenerate projections/work-cell records and reclassify legacy identities before relocation.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Commit regenerated and reclassified records separately from direct moves.

phase_order.purpose: Merge ID-prefixed implementations with corrected wrappers into canonical module code while creating temporary re-export shims.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Commit each canonical implementation pair independently after focused tests pass.

phase_order.purpose: Replace duplicate service-level UI work-cell bindings with one generated U4 canonical record per work-cell identity.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Commit the full UI canonicalization set after UI catalog validation.

phase_order.purpose: Split mixed-responsibility configuration/CLI files and rewrite stale cross-module tests.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Commit each split or rewrite independently.

phase_order.purpose: Delete or archive only artifacts proven inactive, duplicated, malformed, or superseded.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Use a dedicated cleanup commit containing evidence references.

phase_order.purpose: Remove compatibility facades only after all consumers have migrated.
phase_order.commit_boundary: Execute in a later deprecation-exit commit, not during initial relocation.
